items.content_text: So this goes global in 2 months. All the reaction YouTubers are dogging on it as the ultimate P2W garbage fest, when really it looks like one of the least P2W Korean slogs I can recall. A far cry from where the genre was 15 years ago. Only function that’s P2W is just being able to buy gold, but it doesn’t matter because the market is completely player driven. Gameplay itself seems good, graphics look good, and very active balancing in PVE and PVP. Anyone else planning on trying it out?
